items.title: Route `/settings/analytics` renders AnalyticsContainer
acceptance: GIVEN an authenticated user with a selected project
WHEN the browser navigates to a URL matching /settings/analytics
THEN the analytics container screen is displayed at that URL
AND the location, parameters and history behave exactly as in the baseline application

items.title: Endpoint GET /elitea_core/analytics/prompt_lib/{projectId}{expr} (projectAnalytics) [dynamic path template]
acceptance: GIVEN the user performs the project analytics operation
WHEN the client issues the request
THEN it targets GET /elitea_core/analytics/prompt_lib/{projectId}{expr} with the same parameters, body shape and semantics as the baseline
AND the response payload drives the same visible data as in the baseline, with error responses surfaced as an error state instead of a blank screen
